meta.name: elevenlabs-tts
meta.description: This skill converts text to high-quality audio files using ElevenLabs API. Use this skill when users request text-to-speech generation, audio narration, or voice synthesis with customizable voice parameters (stability, similarity boost) and voice presets (rachel, adam, bella, elli, josh, arnold, ava).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文字转为逼真语音，支持多种人声和参数调节
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将文字转为自然语音用于内容创作
copy.tagline_en: Convert text to lifelike speech with customizable voices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn text into natural speech for content creation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将你提供的文字转换成语音文件，支持选择不同声音和调节稳定性、相似度等参数。
howto.when: 当你要求将文字转为语音、生成音频旁白或合成声音时触发。

say.text: 请把这段话转成语音，用亚当的声音。
用贝拉的声音朗读这段文字，稳定性设为0.8。
say.note: Claude 会按参数生成语音。

say.text: 列出所有可用的声音预设。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert your text into audio files using ElevenLabs API, with options to choose voice presets and adjust stability/similarity parameters.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert text to speech, generate audio narration, or synthesize voice.

say_en.text: Convert this text to speech using Adam voice.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an audio file.

say_en.text: Read this text with Bella voice, stability 0.8.
say_en.note: Claude will generate speech with parameters.
Claude will display the voice list.
